source: stringline subway rides plus modelled link legs
combination: Waits, transfers and link rides are convolved. The measured subway ride is added to the modelled overhead, which overstates the tail, so door-to-door figures are conservative.

assumptions.note: Modelled, not observed. The Q70+ ride range comes from figures already averaged over month, weekday and hour, so it is narrower than a rider's experience. Fares are confirmed: AirTrain $8.75, Q70+ free.
